itemKinds.stack: positive quantity with one canonical definition authority
itemKinds.serializedEquipment: exactly one whole item with one exact equipment definition authority and one whole allocation/write

narrative.publicOrOwnerReward: bounded accepted fact projected only to its declared audience
narrative.gmNote: a narrative line with gm visibility; it remains server-private and never becomes hidden mechanics

allocationRules.exactTotals: Non-excluded allocation amounts must sum exactly to the reward amount or quantity; capture and narrative each have an exact amount of one.
allocationRules.whole: A whole method is the only non-excluded allocation for its line and carries the complete amount.
allocationRules.serializedAndCapture: Exactly one whole allocation and exactly one contributing amount-one write with capacity cost one; explicit non-contributing related writes have amount and capacity cost zero.
allocationRules.excluded: Excluded rewards have no active allocations or writes.
allocationRules.pending: Missing, under-, over-, denied, stale, unsupported, capacity-exceeding, or incompletely previewed allocations remain present and pending.

authoritySnapshot.destinationIdentity: one unique current kind and id with an exact revision
authoritySnapshot.permission: one source-authority-backed allowed or denied result; denied requires a stable private reason
authoritySnapshot.capacityRule: All declared writes to one destination are summed before comparing non-negative capacity cost with current used and limit values.
authoritySnapshot.foreignAuthority: A destination or write not referenced by one current allocation is rejected.

requiredFields: non-negative amount plus an explicit counts-toward-allocation marker
writePreview.aggregateRule: Every active allocation has one or more exact previews whose contributing positive amounts sum to that allocation. A source-owned related aggregate mutation may use an explicit non-contributing zero amount. Duplicate source writes or duplicate allocation target fields are rejected.
writePreview.mechanicsRule: A preview describes the complete intended write boundary; P8-075 through P8-078 source providers still calculate and apply their own mechanics.

readiness.eligible: Every non-excluded line is exactly allocated, every allocation is ready, all permissions and revisions are current, capacity fits in aggregate, and every write is previewed.
readiness.blocked: Any validation issue leaves its allocation proposed and reward pending.
readiness.emptyPackage: A package with no reward lines is ready and requires no writes.
readiness.terminalRule: Committed, cancelled, applied, committing, completed, or cancelled state cannot be re-planned.

forbiddenPublicEvidence: permission authority or denied reason identity
GM note text outside GM projection
privacy.projectionRule: Later role projections expose safe labels, quantities, audience-correct notes, capacity outcomes, and disabled reasons without raw authority.
